projection.about: The executed split and seed manifest of the reported run: identities, seeds and role sizes from the released runtime and the effective configuration; graph-level role hashes of the LRGB benchmarks from the official file order (section B of docs/FINAL_DESTINATION.md).
projection.rule: Every value in this file is a projection of the file that publication writes at `replaces`. Real loaders refuse it. `make final-destination-converge` compares the realized file with it: exact values must be identical, registered values follow the registered site profile, sizes must fall within a factor of 2 and counts within 25%, minimums must be reached, and pending values are supplied by the realized output.

seeds.ensemble_seeds: pending: seeds of the selected ensembles

splits.rule: seeded permutation of official train; floor cuts at 60%,80%,90%,95%; fit/explore/select/confirm/compare; validation=admit; test=test
splits.role_hashes: pending: node role hashes; follow from the official node identifiers
splits.official_split_hashes: pending: hashes of the official node splits
splits.arrays: pending: splits.npz, official_splits.npz and clusters.npz with SHA-256 and bytes

source_data.source: pending: provider record of the official release

policy_lock: pending: comparator, deployed-rule and frozen-model hashes of policy_lock.json

environment.platform: pending: platform string of the compute node
environment.numpy: pending: NumPy of the run environment

packages: pending: installed distributions of the run environment
index_arrays_copied: pending: membership arrays copied next to this manifest
